name: id comment: 核销ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: rule_id comment: 规则ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: code_id comment: 优惠码ID（自动折扣为空） constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user_id comment: 用户ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: order_id comment: 订单ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 valid有效/reverted已回滚 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: redeemed_at comment: 核销时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: reverted_at comment: 回滚时间（整单退款触发，空=未回滚） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ref_product comment: 商品域（引用） note: 圈选活动商品时只读；商品折扣命中维度 columns: - name: listing_id comment: 在售商品ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: spu_id comment: SPU ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: category_id comment: 品类ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: brand_id comment: 品牌ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: listing_status comment: 在售状态（下单时实时判定可享，A5） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ref_market comment: market（引用） note: 规则投放市场、币种口径来源 columns: - name: market_id comment: 市场ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: currency_code comment: 币种 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ref_user comment: 用户（引用） note: 核销归属用户，每人限次判定 columns: - name: user_id comment: 用户ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: ref_order comment: 订单-优惠记录（引用） note: order_discount.promotion_ref_id → promotion_rule.id；分摊金额由营销域计算，订单落地存储 columns: - name: order_id comment: 订单ID constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: promotion_ref_id comment: 促销规则ID（指向rule） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: discount_amount comment: 优惠金额（营销计算，订单落库） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: promotion_rule to: promotion type: N:1 label: 归属活动 penwidth: 1.6 - from: promotion_market to: promotion_rule type: N:1 label: 投放市场 penwidth: 1.4 - from: promotion_target to: promotion_rule type: N:1 label: 圈选商品 - from: promotion_code to: promotion_rule type: N:1 label: 优惠码 penwidth: 1.4 - from: promotion_redemption to: promotion_rule type: N:1 label: 核销 penwidth: 1.4 - from: promotion_redemption to: promotion_code type: N:1 label: 码核销 - from: promotion_market to: ref_market type: N:1 label: 引用 color: '#9AA0A6' style: dashed - from: promotion_target to: ref_product type: N:1 label: 引用 color: '#9AA0A6' style: dashed - from: promotion_redemption to: ref_user type: N:1 label: 引用 color: '#9AA0A6' style: dashed - from: promotion_redemption to: ref_order type: N:1 label: 引用 color: '#9AA0A6' style: dashed - from: ref_order to: promotion_rule type: N:1 label: 规则快照引用 color: '#9AA0A6' style: dashed design_rules: 活动-规则-码三层: 活动=分组容器；折扣规则=规则真正载体(聚合根)；优惠码=有码触发凭证。一活动多规则、一规则多码 触发方式: promotion_rule.trigger_type=auto时无码自动生效；=code时挂1~N个promotion_code由用户输码触发 分摊职责: 营销域负责优惠分摊规则定义与行级分摊计算(随试算供给)；订单域负责订单金额计算与分摊数据落地存储 order_discount(域边界 2026-07-26 修正) 订单侧契约: order_discount.promotion_ref_id 指向 promotion_rule.id，promotion_name 存 rule_name 快照 多币种录值: 固定金额/满额门槛/最大优惠封顶按 promotion_market 逐市场币种录入；百分比值全市场统一；汇率模块仅作运营录值时换算参考建议值，不自动生效 用量控制: 总次数看 rule.used_count、每人次数看(rule_id,user_id)计数、码级看 code_id、有效期看活动 start_at/end_at 叠加口径_V1: can_combine=false 的规则同单命中取优惠最大一条；=true 的按顺序作用(百分比基于逐步折后价、固定金额累减)；实付兜底(≥0)由订单计算引擎统一夹逼(A2/D4) 退款回滚: 订单整单退款事件驱动 redemption.status valid→reverted + reverted_at；used_count-1、每人限次释放；部分退款不回滚不重算(D3) 一品一件: 指定商品圈选关系不物理删除；下单按商品域实时可售状态动态判定，售出→暂不可享、退款回可售→自动恢复；全部不可售仅提醒运营不自动结束(A5) 时区口径: promotion.timezone_mode=market(默认)按各市场本地时区判定起止时间，可选 utc(D5) 资损监控_V1: 配置期价格试算拦截提醒 + 到手价降幅监控报警(服务能力不建业务表)；资损对账=日汇总核对 valid核销 vs order_discount(离线任务，报表化V2) 优惠码方式: 手动输入+系统随机生成两种；手动码防猜校验(长度≥8、字母数字混合、禁纯连续序列)，规则落PRD不加字段(D6) V2预留: budget_total/budget_spent(预算池)、阶梯门槛、eligibility(人群定向)、combines_with类别叠加模型、一人一码max_uses、活动维度聚合统计 均本版不落逻辑 范围_V1: 仅平台运营创建；折扣成本默认平台承担；三方商家自主营销为后续版本
